items.title: OpenCode ships experimental background compaction: context is summarized while the agent keeps working instead of pausing the session
items.summary: OpenCode added an experimental setting that compacts long coding-agent sessions in the background, so long runs no longer stop and wait while history is summarized. The OpenCode developer says prompt caching behaves as before.

doubt.pushback: No numbers or docs yet; one replier says OpenAI native compaction only works with the legacy auth method, and others ask whether early constraints survive compaction.

reception.summary: Repliers welcome no longer freezing mid-task, ask how it works and for per-model thresholds, and note Pi had a similar feature first; @kitlangton quote-posted that it works well.

items.title: omarchy-apple-dev: an agent builds, signs and installs an iPad app from Linux over Tailscale with no Mac in the path
items.summary: Open-source tooling that lets a coding agent build and sign iOS/iPadOS SwiftUI apps on Linux (x86_64 or Apple Silicon) without Xcode and push them to a device over the network. The author's orchestrator agent used it to build its own iPhone and iPad task app.

doubt.pushback: New repo with no stars or third-party reproduction yet; only the author's demo.

items.title: Baseten Loops SDK adds Meta Muse Spark Open for post-training with your own data and reward functions, then one-step deploy
items.summary: Teams can now RL or fine-tune Meta's open Muse Spark model on Baseten Loops with custom reward functions while Baseten runs training and sampling, then deploy the checkpoint straight to an inference endpoint.

items.title: Google DeepMind paper: self-rewarded RL on moral argumentation makes Gemma-4 4B more decisive but not more valid
items.summary: A self-judged RL tournament on SMT-verified dilemmas halves order flips on MoralChoice (14.3% to 6.6%), but sycophancy stays flat, framing acceptance rises and MORABLES accuracy drops 3.1 points. A measured warning for anyone using consistency or self-reward as a training signal.
